newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling strengthens slightly against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling strengthens slightly against dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling opened the week slightly stronger against the dollar on Monday in a quiet market, commercial bank dealers said.
The central bank posted the shilling at a mean rate of 54.86 against the dollar from 54.88 on Friday. Against the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean rate of 88.90 from 88.95 on Friday.
The money market was liquid with overnight rates quoted below 10 percent.
